def format_usd(amount):
    negative = amount < 0
    value = abs(amount)
    formatted = f'{value:,.2f}'
    sign = '-' if negative else ''
    return f'{sign}${formatted}'

def format_cents(cents):
    negative = cents < 0
    value = abs(cents)
    dollars = value // 100
    remainder = value % 100
    formatted = f'{dollars:,}.{remainder:02d}'
    sign = '-' if negative else ''
    return f'{sign}${formatted}'

def format_currency_no_cents(amount):
    rounded = round(amount)
    negative = rounded < 0
    value = abs(rounded)
    formatted = f'{value:,}'
    sign = '-' if negative else ''
    return f'{sign}${formatted}'

def format_price_range(low, high):
    return f'${low:,.2f}-${high:,.2f}'

def format_percent_no_trailing_zero(fraction):
    pct = round(fraction * 100, 2)
    s = f'{pct:.2f}'
    s = s.rstrip('0').rstrip('.')
    return s + '%'
